host: 6 vCPU shared host; every run records its own load average with the measurement

measurement.note: the push's test-bearing set, measured at the base revision and at this change on the same host in back-to-back runs (load average 1.6-3.0 before, 0.4 during). The offline subset's other steps are unchanged by this unit and cost 1-3 s on both sides, so each class total adds them.

classes.note: test-impact answers empty, so the test-bearing steps are skipped on both sides; the offline steps are what a docs-only push spends
the test-bearing set plus the offline steps: crate-suite-bun 240 s -> 89 s is the delta, the rest is unchanged
a package change dispatches the same test-bearing set as a script change, so the same two measurements are its own
